app.title: Bitschmiede
app.subtitle: One studio, sixty years of games
app.intro: 1980, a garage, two founders. Make games, release them and find out why the press rates them the way it does.
time.limit: Ten years without an event; stopped.
studio.title: Work
studio.empty: Nothing is running. Start a project or wait for a contract.
save.title: Saved games
save.name: Name
save.dataChanged: Loaded. The game data changed since saving; the course of the game may differ.
save.tablesChanged: Loaded. The calculation tables changed; the course of the game may differ.
save.tooOld: This save is too old for this version.
save.tooNew: This save comes from a newer version.
save.noMigration: A conversion for this save is missing.
save.invalid: This is not a saved game.
save.ironman: Ironman: one save per game, saved automatically. Loading only from the start screen.
studio.resumeHint: Resume with all free people; three weeks of onboarding.
start.noLock: Press randomness and decision density never lock achievements.
start.ironman.text: A single save that is written automatically; no loading during the game.
preset.entspannt.text: For trying things out: mistakes cost little and the company survives almost anything.
preset.leicht.text: A newcomer gets through the 80s and learns every system along the way.
preset.normal.text: A good player survives the 90s; a very good one leads the engine charts in 2010.
preset.schwer.text: Every flop hurts, the AI fights for every customer, loans are expensive.
preset.hardcore.text: One weak release can be the end; for experts only.
tabs.label: Sections
audio.title: Settings
audio.keys: Keys: space pause/1×, 0 = 0.5×, 1/2/3 = 1×/2×/4×, N = until next event, Esc closes.
start.space.hint: How many workplaces and equipment slots each layout has.
start.goal.hint: Optional: one big goal for the whole game. With the game end setting “goal”, the game ends once it is reached.
start.endMode.hint: When the game ends. You can always keep playing afterwards, except after bankruptcy and after 2100.
start.endMode.zielbedingung: When the long-term goal is reached
start.scenario.hint: A scenario sets the start year, studio and a goal with a deadline. Only the difficulty can be chosen.
audio.pauseHint: Otherwise the game only pauses for key moments (gate, review, critical bug, release duel, price shock, poaching). Other offers wait in the decisions panel with a deadline; when it expires, the default answer applies.
quit.hint: Quit to the start screen (new game or load a save)
quit.title: Quit game
quit.body: Back to the start screen, where you can start a new game or load a save. Save this game to an autosave slot first?
quit.ironman: Ironman: the game is saved to its single slot and can be continued later.
start.guide: How do you want to start?
start.guide.gefuehrt.text: A learning path shows you step by step what to do. Easy difficulty; new areas open one by one.
start.guide.klassisch.text: Choose every setting yourself. No learning path, but a short card for each new area.
start.guide.frei.text: For experts: all areas open right away, no hints.
start.guide.easy: Guided starts in 1980 in a garage, difficulty “Easy”, calm event density. Just pick your founder's strength.
feedback.hint: Send bugs, ideas or praise to the developers
feedback.title: Give feedback
feedback.intro: Thanks for playing! Every bit of feedback helps, even one sentence.
feedback.severity: How much does it bother you?
feedback.textBug: What did you do? What happened? What did you expect?
feedback.textOther: Tell us what you noticed or what you would like.
feedback.contactHint: in case we may ask back
start.year.hint: Any year from {from} to {to}. You start in a garage with two founders; platforms, competitors, wages and press expectations match the year.
mods.title: Mods
mods.intro: Mods change game data (genres, themes, cards, platforms, starting values) or add texts. They apply to every new game and to loaded saves.
mods.importError: “{file}” is not a mod file (the manifest is missing).
mods.achievementLock: At least one active mod changes balance: achievements are locked in these games. Purely cosmetic mods lock nothing.
mods.order: Order: base game, then dependencies and “loadAfter”, then this list from top to bottom. If two mods change the same field, the one loaded later wins.
mods.running: Mods can only be changed on the start screen.
save.modMissing: This save was made with a mod that is not active. It continues without it.
save.modFallback: Some genres, themes, platforms or cards from a missing mod were replaced.
display.title: Display and accessibility
display.colorblind: Colour-blind mode: blue and orange instead of green and red, patterns in charts
display.mentorMuted: Mute mentor (no tips at release or first times; everything is in the handbook)
display.bubblesMuted: Mute speech bubbles (no bubbles on stage)
display.hint: These settings apply to this device, not to the save, and never lock achievements. Tab reaches every control; the focus outline shows where you are.
start.profile.publisher: Publisher: lots of capital, two partner studios, publish other studios' games
